source_quotes.quote: Teaching venue: BERGAMO, MILANO; Duration: 6 years; Language: English; Access mode: National programmed (48 Places).

[English translation] The Medicine & Surgery programme is established as an inter-university programme and, at the end of the studies, the Master's Degree in Medicine and Surgery is awarded jointly by the University of Milano-Bicocca and the University of Bergamo. Administrative seat: Milano-Bicocca. Language of delivery: English.

[English translation] If you are interested in the six-year, single-cycle, inter-university degree programme in Medicine and Surgery (nationally programmed access), delivered in English, contact the University of Milano-Bicocca.
[English translation] Medicine and Surgery — inter-university programme with the University of Milan-Bicocca — information on the selective IMAT test is available on this page.

[English translation] The comprehensive contribution is calculated on the basis of the ISEEU value. The amount also varies according to the programme, year of enrolment and type of enrolment (full-time or part-time).

uncertainty_notes: Priority was given to academic year 2026/2027. UniBg confirms that the programme is active, English-taught, six years, LM-41, jointly awarded, nationally programmed with 48 places, and administratively based at Milano-Bicocca. However, UniBg's 2026/2027 student guide delegates admission enquiries to Milano-Bicocca, while the accessible UniBg IMAT page is labelled 2025/2026. Under the research restriction to unibg.it sources only, no external Milano-Bicocca or national call was used to fill deadlines, document requirements, English-certificate thresholds, scoring, fee applicability, or EU/non-EU seat allocations.
source_access_status: UniBg pages were accessed through current official-site search indexing and accessible official HTML pages. The main programme and admission pages returned HTTP 403 on direct open, so some facts were verified from current search-indexed page text; the DIGIP departmental page and the 2026/2027 UniBg e-learning student guide were directly accessible.
